300:548.en: 「I, $$ロジャー・スミス$$,\nwill face you.」

300:1111.en: 「Hope it's the last\nI hit a woman...」

300:1305.en: 「Etch this light's path in your eyes!」

300:1895.en: 「See the answer with your own eyes!」

300:2429.en: 「By $$ロジャー・スミス$$'s name,\nI judge you!!」

300:2584.en: 「$$ビッグオー$$, stop\nthem having their way!」

300:2647.en: 「I'm a man who values fair play...!」

300:2682.en: 「In any age, some\nsolve all by force!」

300:3480.en: 「$$ビッグオー$$ is anything but sluggish!」

300:3523.en: 「$$ノーマン$$ would mind any scratches.」

300:3593.en: 「$$ビッグオー$$ seems to be running well.」

300:3761.en: 「The foe is $$ベック$$. It can't be helped.」

300:3853.en: 「I know how to defend myself too.」

300:3894.en: 「Never meant\nto use you as a shield.」

300:5503.en: 「Dorothy, if it comes to it, eject!」

300:5734.en: 「You really don't like them, do you?」

300:5773.en: 「$$ロジャー$$,\nlet's beat them to a pulp.」

300:5877.en: 「I don't want the world you'd create.」

300:5943.en: 「The power of $$ロジャー$$, $$ビッグオー$$, and me.」

300:6226.en: 「$$ノーマン$$ will be pleased too.」

300:7062.en: 「When can I\nfocus on my real work...?」

300:7123.en: 「$$ビッグオー$$, I'm counting on you...!」

300:7207.en: 「No need to hold back, $$ビッグオー$$!」

300:7600.en: 「$$ベック$$! That vulgar laugh ends now!」

300:7643.en: 「Your machine is as crude as you...!」

300:7803.en: 「I'd hoped not to face a Gundam.」

300:8262.en: 「At least, it's not\nmy notion of God!」

300:8411.en: 「$$ビッグオー$$, can you handle a fast foe?」

300:8558.en: 「It feels unfair, but so be it.」

300:8601.en: 「I feel lost\nin a fable or novel!」

300:9114.en: 「Those who steal freedom\nwill face me and $$ビッグオー$$!」

300:9169.en: 「The time for talks is past...!\nYou brought this force on yourself!」

300:9234.en: 「Power is good or evil depending\non its user. I feel that keenly...!」

300:9332.en: 「It seems even Death hates you,\n$$アサキム$$...!」

300:9442.en: 「You're unworthy of the name of god!」

300:9481.en: 「No one in this world\nknows everything! Nor is one needed!」

300:9550.en: 「In short, the audience doesn't\nwant the ending you've written!」

300:10002.en: 「There is no room left to negotiate!」

300:10462.en: 「This cheap $$メガデウス$$ will beat me?」

300:11649.en: 「$$ロジャー・スミス$$, amnesiac city agent.」

300:11714.en: 「Wait, $$ビッグオー$$. This is my job.」

300:11759.en: 「We need rest, and a way to enjoy it.」

300:11870.en: 「R. Dorothy: black, no milk or sugar.」

300:12089.en: 「Done for now? I'll rest a while too.」

300:12164.en: 「You're the lead. No tale lacks one.」

300:12237.en: 「I'm still $$ロジャー$$. You stay the hero.」

300:12316.en: 「Till next time in Super Robot Wars.」
